parameters.toolDescription: Scan a public GitHub repo with Flowscope. Returns what the app does, every outside service it talks to, and the top safety risks. Input: the repo as owner/name, for example vercel/next.js.

parameters.name: audit_n8n_workflow
parameters.description: Audit an n8n workflow for security holes: keys typed into nodes, webhooks or MCP servers with no lock, AI agents that can send or change things with no human approval, and no error workflow. Input: the full workflow JSON as text (what you get from Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C in the n8n editor). Returns a health score and numbered fixes.

parameters.name: check_code_for_keys
parameters.description: Check code or a git diff for leaked API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, AWS, GitHub, Google, Apify, Slack) and secrets read in browser code. Use before every commit. Input: the code or diff as text. Returns line numbers, never the key values.

parameters.content:
## Flowscope: MCP server
Lets Claude, Cursor or any MCP client use Flowscope as tools.

1. In **Flowscope MCP**, create a **Bearer Auth** credential with a long random token. Never leave an MCP server on None: Flowscope flags that.
2. In **scan_github_repo**, replace YOUR-NAME in the URL with the Production URL of the scan-repo workflow (it must be Active).
3. Activate this workflow and copy the **Production URL** of **Flowscope MCP**.
4. Add it to your MCP client (see SETUP.md, step 7).
